blocks: Adds git worktree management, a live dashboard, agent control, and a status sidebar on top of tmux rather than replacing it; includes tmux session-manager integration and sandboxing for agent work.
Covered by DevOps Toolbox (Person/Omer Hamerman) in I Don't Want a New Terminal. I Want THIS for Tmux. — the video's audio transcribes the name as "Workmax"/"Workmix"; the real project is workmux.
